verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents an automated hire-and-onboard flow that starts with offer letters (docs-16). It also documents secure upload and storage of employee documents within individual employee profiles (docs-12), which covers the per-employee storage half of the story. However, no evidence explicitly mentions e-signature, so signing offer letters and HR documents is only implied by the onboarding-flow claim. Missing for 10: explicit e-signature capability for offer letters and HR documents, detail on whether signed documents are stored automatically per employee, independent or hands-on corroboration.
